sloka: द्वाराणां परिघाणां च गिरीणामपि भेदनम् ।नानारुधिरसिक्ताङ्गं मेदोदिग्धं सुदारुणम् ।। ६.१११.९ ।।
transliteration: dvārāṇāṁ parighāṇāṁ ca girīṇāmapi bhedanam ।nānārudhirasiktāṅgaṁ medodigdhaṁ sudāruṇam ।। 6.111.9 ।।

translations.english: Capable of splitting gateways, iron bars, even mountains, smeared with blood and brain marrow of various Asuras, of dreadful appearance.
